what_it_is: The REDEVELOPED build's scene: one self-contained HTML (1080×1920), deterministic renderAt(t), word animation for 128 span-carried words + 4 tile-carried words (132 total), the A59 tile system, the cinematic monument, the 2D definition cut. Timings: ASR (faster-whisper base) on the fitted stems, script-word aligned; L5's word timings are ESTIMATES from the i2 clone take's identical count (no L5 take exists). NO AUDIO IS EMBEDDED: the programme audio does not exist (audio/audio.json — L5 block), so standalone playback runs a visual-only preview clock, labeled as such in the scene's code and title; the ?render path stays inert for frame capture. When L5 resolves, the assembled programme audio is embedded and this record is updated.
style: A59 spine + cinematic typography (number) + 2D cut (definition) — DR-STYLE, decisions/decisions.json; base-layer field in metadata.json
timing_basis: words.json in the job folder (hidden_files/wd01-redevelop/): ASR on fitted stems for L1–L4, L6–L8; L5 estimated

supersedes.note: the superseded scene file itself stays on the branch until the main agent's commit replaces it; its hashes are cited here and in DR-SUPERSESSION

editability: The superseded scene's EDITABILITY-2 layer does not carry to this scene (its join keys were the old PLAN). Re-proving editability (b) on the redeveloped scene is a follow-up job — recorded, not implied.
